meta.name: Gaze-Aware Avatar Study
meta.description: Within-subjects study comparing baseline and gaze-aware avatar conditions during a quiz conversation.

steps.title: Eyes On Me
steps.tagline: Velorian Ministry · Office of Director Vane
steps.order_text: Stay calm. Do not get caught.

sections.title: Who You Are
sections.body: You are Agent Miller, an undercover operative. You have successfully infiltrated the Velorian Ministry.

sections.title: The Situation
sections.body: You are in the office of Director Vane for a routine security review. He is cold, highly suspicious, and watching you closely.

sections.title: Your Objective
sections.body: Gather as much intelligence as possible for your post-briefing evaluation.

tactics.text: Listen. Memorize names, dates, and other clues Vane mentions.
Observe. Scan the room for visual clues.

sections.title: How to Survive — Suspicion
sections.body: Scanning the room while Vane makes direct eye contact raises his suspicion. If suspicion peaks, you will be arrested.

tactics.text: Avoid detection. Don't look around while he's watching you.
Safe windows. Look around only when Vane is turned away or distracted.
Return eye contact. Look back at Vane the instant he turns to face you.

debriefing.title: Recall Report
debriefing.instruction: Before HQ closes the file, confirm what you saw and heard. Answer from memory — the record is graded on accuracy.

items.text: Which specific date was circled on the wall calendar?
items.section_note: Recall what you observed at the scene.

items.text: What item was the missing dockworker Nikolai Vance last seen carrying?
What color was the stolen keycard mentioned in the newspaper article?
Where was the red X marked on the wall map?
What is the case file number on the desk folder?
What phone extension was scribbled on the desk notepad?
What is the official codename of the Ministry's upcoming military operation?
items.section_note: Recall what was said during the interrogation.

items.text: What is the name of the cargo vessel the rebels are using?
At what specific time is the Ministry planning to initiate the raid?
Who did Director Vane identify as the rogue contact inside the Ministry?
What emergency radio frequency or channel did Director Vane mention?
What is the secret verbal password for the field agents?
What security clearance level does an agent need to transmit on the emergency radio channel?
items.section_note: Connect the visual evidence with what you heard.

items.text: What item did Nikolai Vance carry that is required to unlock the main gate at the Old Embankment?

feedback.title: Additional Feedback
feedback.instruction: If you would like, you can share any additional comments about the interaction.

questions.text: What is the capital of France?
Who was the first person to walk on the Moon?
Who developed the theory of relativity?
In which country is the Great Sphinx located?
Which ocean is the largest on Earth?
Which planet is the largest in the solar system?
What ship sank in 1912 after hitting an iceberg?
Which is the largest land animal?

nodes.speaker: Director Vane
nodes.direction: Vane looks directly at the player. His expression is calm but cold.
nodes.text: Sit down, Agent Miller. I've been reviewing our internal security protocols. These are tense times in Veloria. Treason is like a disease... silent, until it's too late. But I'm sure you agree.

nodes.speaker: Director Vane
nodes.text: We are launching a decisive strike to crush the rebels. This campaign is officially designated as Operation Aurora. It must succeed.

nodes.speaker: Director Vane
nodes.direction: Vane looks down. He is no longer looking at the player. [Opportunity 1 - Safe Window]: the player can safely scan the room without increasing suspicion.
nodes.text: Let me sign these transfer papers first... We cannot afford any bureaucratic delays when the city is on the brink of chaos.

nodes.speaker: Director Vane
nodes.text: I'm sharing this setup with you because I need absolute discretion. We have a suspected mole in our communications division. We believe a corrupt officer named Thomas is feeding data to the rebels. Keep your eyes open.

nodes.speaker: Director Vane
nodes.text: Miller, you seem preoccupied today. Make sure your head is in the game. We have no room for distractions.

nodes.speaker: Director Vane
nodes.direction: Vane leans forward slightly, continuing the briefing.
nodes.text: Our intelligence confirms the Vanguard has acquired weaponized cargo. They have loaded it onto a civilian freighter named The Hermes. They think they can slip out under the cover of darkness. They are wrong. We raid the harbor at exactly 03:00 AM.

nodes.speaker: Director Vane
nodes.direction: Vane sighs, turning his head completely to look at the wall map. [Opportunity 2 - Safe Window]: the player can safely scan the room again.
nodes.text: Look at the layout of the city... The harbor districts are a maze. A tactical nightmare.

nodes.speaker: Director Vane
nodes.direction: Vane mutters to himself while studying the map. The player can safely scan the room during this line, then Vane turns back to face the player at the end.
nodes.text: The docks at sector four are heavily guarded, but the northern channels... they are completely exposed. If they reach open water, we lose them.

nodes.speaker: Director Vane
nodes.direction: Branch 2A: Low Suspicion (player maintained appropriate eye contact).
nodes.text: Since I can trust you, keep this backup frequency in mind. If our primary comms go dark, and only if you have clearance for Case #A7-12, tune your radio to Channel 16.

nodes.speaker: Director Vane
nodes.text: If our primary comms go dark, we will rely on standard localized patrols. I was going to share the emergency backup frequencies with you, but you seem too distracted today to handle sensitive intelligence. Let's stick to the basic protocols.

nodes.speaker: Director Vane
nodes.direction: The retro desk phone rings. Vane picks up the receiver, turning his head slightly away.

nodes.speaker: Director Vane
nodes.direction: [Opportunity 3 - Safe Window]: the NPC is holding the phone/looking slightly away — the player's final safe chance to scan the room.
nodes.text: Yes?... No, I am in a briefing... What? The perimeter guards at the old embankment are complaining about the cold? Tell them to stay alert, the Vanguard is active tonight. Understood, reinforce the guards at sector seven as well. I don't want any surprises... No, I will call you back on the secure line in five minutes. Just get it done.

nodes.speaker: Director Vane
nodes.direction: Ending A: Successful Departure (Suspicion is LOW). Vane hangs up the phone and looks back at the player.
nodes.text: That was headquarters. The wheels are in motion. If you do need to use that backup frequency we discussed, the secret verbal password is Red Sky to verify your identity. Go back to your desk and prepare your report, Agent Miller. Let us hope, for your sake, that our operation goes flawlessly. You are dismissed.

nodes.speaker: Director Vane
nodes.direction: Ending B: Arrested (Suspicion is HIGH). Sound of a door slamming open and heavy footsteps.
nodes.text: Actually, Miller... I cannot let you leave this office. Your nervous behavior today confirms my worst fears. You've been staring at my map and my files since you walked in. Guards! Detain Agent Miller immediately!
